# TC.StartEvent

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.StartEvent"></a>

### TC.StartEvent

The host queues this event once on explicit successful Run/Apply when start is exported.
Validation, Save, ordinary cold load and electrical cycling do not generate this event.

Extends: TC.BaseEvent

### name

Startup event discriminator.

```text
'start'
```
